attachment.title: PCC-57 Referral Outcome — OMG^O19 + C-CDA Consultation Note

note.text: Represents the C-CDA Consultation Note component of the PCC-57 (Referral Outcome) 360X transaction that transmits John's dental clearance from Penn Dental to FCCC. Per the ode-360x-adapter crosswalk, PCC-57 travels as OMG^O19 + an accompanying C-CDA document; this DocumentReference is the FHIR-side representation of that document, listed as part of Task.output alongside ClinicalImpression, Procedure, and the disposition Observation.
